parameters.name: AuthVersion
parameters.description:
The authorization version of the asset. Valid values:
- **6**: Anti-virus Edition
- **5**: Premium Edition
- **3**: Enterprise Edition
- **7**: Ultimate Edition
- **10**: value-added service Edition.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryUid
parameters.description: The UID of the resource directory.
